shapeSummary: 96 mm diameter, 32 mm wide wheel with its axis along Z, centered at X=0, Z=0, and Y=48 so the bottom sits at Y=0. It has a 10 mm thick outer ring (OD 96, ID 76) and an internal 8 mm hub plate at Z -8 to 0. This leaves an 8 mm recess on one side and a 16 mm recess on the other. The plate has a 14 mm through bore and 45 holes of 4 mm diameter on an 8 mm grid.
warnings: The 4 mm hole positions were estimated from the drawing's grid and should be verified.
The four slots next to the bore were omitted because their dimensions are uncertain.
The stepped rim, rubber tread profile and the small lip at the plate junction were simplified to a plain ring.
The Z sign convention is arbitrary: the 8 mm recess is at Z -16 to -8 and the 16 mm recess is at Z 0 to 16.
cadquery:
rows = {32:[-8,0,8], 24:[-16,-8,0,8,16], 16:[-24,-16,-8,8,16,24], 8:[-32,-24,-16,-8,8,24,32], 0:[-32,-24,24,32], -8:[-32,-24,-16,-8,8,24,32], -16:[-24,-16,-8,8,16,24], -24:[-16,-8,0,8,16], -32:[-8,0,8]}
pts = [(x, y + 48) for y, xs in rows.items() for x in xs]
ring = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-16).center(0, 48).circle(48).circle(38).extrude(32)
plate = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-8).center(0, 48).circle(38).extrude(8)
part = ring.union(plate)
bore = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-8).center(0, 48).circle(7).extrude(8)
holes = cq.Workplane('XY').workplane(offset=-8).pushPoints(pts).circle(2).extrude(8)
part = part.cut(bore).cut(holes)
